d:
Union Minister Ramdas Athawale has invited CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke to join the Republican Party of India (Athawale). The offer comes despite Dipke’s protests against the Modi government. Dipke had earlier questioned Athawale, asking why he was being invited after being called “anti-national” a month earlier. He has not yet responded to the latest offer.
